reviews.author: Ananya Verma
reviews.title: Authentic Alizarin Dyes and Flawless Edge Print
reviews.content: The vegetable dye aroma is completely pure and natural. The weight of the hand-spun mulmul is breathtakingly soft. Truly museum grade craftsmanship!
